key_moments: Leroy Sané opened the scoring for Germany in the 2nd minute.
Nilson Angulo equalized for Ecuador with a long-range strike in the 9th minute.
Gonzalo Plata scored the winning goal for Ecuador in the 77th minute.
Piero Hincapié (Ecuador) received a yellow card in the 43rd minute.
Aleksandar Pavlović (Germany) received a yellow card in the 44th minute.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the decisive winning goal and was instrumental in Ecuador's attack.
Scored a crucial equalizer early in the match, shifting momentum.
Scored Germany's only goal early on, showcasing his attacking threat.

matches.tactical_summary: Germany started strong with an early goal and a high press, but struggled to maintain consistency and possession throughout the match. Ecuador capitalized on counterattacks and effective wing play, demonstrating resilience to come from behind and secure a crucial victory.

narrative: Ecuador secured a dramatic 2-1 comeback victory over Germany, with Gonzalo Plata scoring the late winner, which propelled them into the Round of 32 as one of the best third-placed teams. Despite the loss, Germany maintained their top spot in Group E, while Ivory Coast secured second place with their win against Curaçao.
